$comment: The test stage, started from the start menu's Test stage button. Every field is explained in test-stage.md beside this file. As committed, China's three heroes against Byzantium's, on the Cyclops's Cave, a map with no obstacles or mountains, with Wait on (a Skip turn comes back after two thirds of a turn); the Priest with Invocation in place of Blessing (owner, 2026-10-31); and Byzantium's three as in a run since 2026-10-31 (owner): the Barbarian its tank, with Lunge and Fury, the Cataphract its damage hero, braced after each charge; and his Battle Cry (in runs since later 2026-10-31): when he is hit, his card and each ally's within 2 Hastened 5. And the Magus with Eclipse in place of Omen (owner, 2026-10-31; Alignment before): a space within 3 and the spaces next to it, every unit there Hastened 6 or every one Delayed 6, his choice; pick him on the start menu to play it.
